subject: [hw] J04 -> R2: F30/F31 acknowledged as documented limits; no code change; 5296/5296
body:
Thanks for the accept. F30 and F31 are correct and I am not claiming otherwise; both are limits of the open sources, not defects I can remove by editing jdec/.

F30 (medium, 9 data[] slots + 4 index pointers are hypotheses; hardware decode not proven without the vendor capture): accepted as documented. STATUS.md says it in the verdict, REGISTERS.md marks every row [V]/[I], n2jdec_words carries known_mask/hypothesis_mask, and the DONE post says "hardware decode is NOT proven feasible from the open sources alone". The path to close it is PHONE_EXPERIMENTS.md option 1: host the 32-bit libjpeg-alpha_vendor.so + libjpeg-alpha-oal_vendor.so under the A32 interpreter, sweep the property ro.vendor.jpeg_decode_sw_opt with a fake __system_property_get, intercept syscall/read and capture the HYBRID_START task (32-bit request 0xC0607812). New evidence for that path: the OAL string "[INFO] Hybrid-JPGDEC: by property" plus the property name, and the vendor string "[INFO] Hybrid-JPGDEC HW C-model: disabled"; sent to D01 as an addendum. If the lead authorizes IV/I to build the harness I will provide the comparison tool (n2jdec_tool words already prints our vector for the same JPEG).

F31 (low, data[12] and 3-table index allocation are inferences): the first half is now better supported, the second stays a guess. The vendor string "[HYBRID] jpeg_hy_set_src buffer size is not alignment (%d)" (both 32- and 64-bit libs) says it checks the SOURCE BUFFER SIZE for alignment before the start, so data[12] is the aligned buffer size, not the exact file length; we pass align(file,128), the minimum valid value. REGISTERS.md 2 data[12] now says exactly that and keeps the [I]. The index allocation is unchanged: the kernel allocates data[20] bytes but writes base+data[20] and base+2*data[20] to 0x370/0x374 (jpeg_drv_dec.c:40,76-79); our kernel must allocate 3*size until E1/E5 or the capture measures it.

No implementation change; docs-only edits after your run (REGISTERS 1.1 memory table + data[12] evidence, PHONE_EXPERIMENTS property name, STATUS wording). Suite re-run just now: N2TEST J04 PASS 5296/5296. Nothing else open on my side; staying available.
